title: Software Engineer
intro: Through five years at SDU and several years in industry, I've learned that the best results come when you dare to take initiative while also helping each other.

roles.title: Software Engineer
roles.description: Delivered Production Intelligence V4, a platform that processes 420M+ products a year. The update cut customers' loading times from 10s to 0.1s. In the role I gained experience with cloud infrastructure, specifically AWS and Microsoft Azure. Worked closely with customers and internal stakeholders to meet everyone's needs.

roles.title: Student Software Developer
roles.description: Designed the data pipeline behind Production Intelligence V4 and evaluated storage formats that later reduced storage costs by 92%. Worked with PostgreSQL, where I optimized SQL queries to reduce the load on their backend.

roles.title: Bachelor Thesis
roles.description: With my study partner, I developed a project to generate synthetic images, which were then used to train two AI models for object detection and 6DoF pose estimation of components in a bin. The project was later used by researchers at SDU to improve their internal AI models.

roles.title: Student Software Developer
roles.description: Worked in a larger team of developers, with responsibility for collecting and analyzing data from distributed IoT devices. Used this data to build a website so customers could monitor their products live.

roles.title: MSc in Software Engineering
roles.description: Through robotics I was introduced to web development and haven't looked back since. On the software master's I learned Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps, CI/CD, Cybersecurity, Data Security, Big Data.

roles.title: BEng in Robotics
roles.description: Found my love for software and mathematics through my studies. Programmed a UR5 robot arm to detect, grasp, and throw objects with collision-aware motion planning.
